scene: In a tranquil stone courtyard during a lantern festival at blue hour, rising lightly onto tiptoe to hook a small unlettered paper lantern onto a low wooden hanging rack. One hand holds the lantern handle, the other rests naturally at her side. Warm lanterns and tiled roofs, no other people.
outfit: Contemporary hanbok-inspired two-piece fashion: opaque ivory sleeveless cropped wrap jeogori with secure crossed front, coral-red high-waisted flowing wrap skirt with a restrained side opening, narrow saffron ribbon and small flame-shaped hair pin. Bare shoulders, arms and a small midriff gap, lightweight fabric, no armor or gloves.
custom: Vertical 2:3, 1024x1536. Same clearly adult woman. Two human hands with five separate anatomical fingers each; lantern held by its handle with an easy open grip, no hidden additional fingers. No readable text, logo or weapon.
